items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the equivalence of four conditions characterizing quasi-coherence of a module on an algebraic space: quasi-coherence itself, quasi-coherence after pullback along a surjective-on-points etale morphism, after pullback along a surjective etale chart by a scheme, and after pullback along every affine etale chart (statement lines 5608-5624). The proof (proof lines 5626-5655) chains the implications, using local presentations of the pullback to obtain presentations on every object of the etale site, and reduces the last condition to affine charts. H2: a cycle of implications with two inputs, written out in full.
